image_description: A mature male orangutan with long reddish-brown fur and prominent cheek pads is sitting on the ground in an enclosure. It is holding a thick wooden stick or branch in its left hand, while its right arm rests near its lap. A human hand is visible in the top-left corner, seemingly offering food. The background consists of a beige wall and some green foliage.
